Beginning an independent chronology review of Jin Shu chapter 53 on Crown Prince Minhuai. Claims, people, and dates will be checked against the Chinese source text.

Systematic review of every claim against the Chinese source. Key figures identified: Sima Yu, Crown Prince Minhuai, son of Emperor Hui and Lady Xie, and his early age at five.

Chronological details mapped from the Chinese source. Sima Yu was made Prince of Guangling after astrologers detected imperial aura. He became Crown Prince upon Emperor Hui's accession. In Yuankang year 1 (291 AD) he moved to the Eastern Palace. The mulberry omen occurred in Yuankang year 9 (299 AD). Empress Jia plotted to depose him in the twelfth month. He was imprisoned at Xuchang in the following January. He was murdered at age 23 in March. He was buried at Xianping in June. Sima Bin died in Yongkang year 1 (300 AD). Posthumous titles were granted in the fourth month.

Additional dates mapped from the Chinese source. Sima Lun usurped in Yongning year 1 first month. Sima Zang was killed and posthumously named Ai in Tai'an year 1 third month guimao. Sima Shang became Prince of Xiangyang in Yongkang year 1 fourth month. He was made imperial grandson-heir in Yongning year 1 eighth month. He died in Tai'an year 1 third month guimao. Era conversions verified: Emperor Hui ascended in 290 AD. Yuankang year 1 is 291 AD. The mulberry omen in Yuankang year 9 is 299 AD. The twelfth month of Yuankang 9 may be late 299 or early 300. The following January is Yongkang year 1 first month. That is 300 AD. The March murder is also 300

A critical calendar discrepancy emerged. If the mulberry omen is Yuankang year 9 (299 AD), then the twelfth month of that year is late 299. The following January would then be Yongkang year 1 (300 AD). This conflicts with claims treating that same December as AD 300. The exact conversion between these eras needs verification.

The Chinese text explicitly states the twelfth month of Yuankang year 9. This confirms the 12th lunar month falls in late 299 AD. The instructions clarify that conventional regnal year labels need not equal the Gregorian year of every month or day within them.

Academia Sinica defaults to Julian before 1582. Verified month and day events must be normalized to proleptic Gregorian. A fixed offset cannot be applied across centuries. Reigned-year labels alone cannot specify a Gregorian event date. The December of Yuankang year 9 may actually be AD 299 rather than 300. Historical knowledge will be consulted to resolve this conversion.

Standard historical consensus places the Crown Prince's deposition in Yuankang year 9 twelfth month (late 299 AD) and his murder in Yongkang year 1 third month (300 AD). I will verify these era conversions through targeted research and cite specific source pages before finalizing the artifact.
I'll start by locating the sealed evidence and calendar references, then check every owned claim against the Chinese text.

Verifying calendar conversions and source page details. Key dates to confirm include Emperor Hui's accession and the Yuankang year.

Checking additional dates and calendar conversions. Verifying whether December equals 299 or 300. Confirming whether the June 300 AD hints in p002, p038, and p015 are accurate. Also validating the year 300 AD entries for Cheng Ju, Yan Zuan, Lu Ji, and Zhang Hua.

Checking p011 and p029 for AD 300 entries. Sima Yu's age of 23 in 300 would imply a birth year near 278, but the instructions forbid deriving precise birth years from inclusive age. The 同生 twin inference rule does not apply here.

Claim-104 appears correct: if December belongs to Yuankang 9 (conventionally 299), then next January is Yongkang 1 (300). Claim-103 is likely wrong, since December of Yuankang 9 conventionally falls in 299. For p002, the AD 300 hint may correspond to the Emperor sentencing Yu at Shi-Qian Hall in s0058.

The Emperor Hui entries in 300 AD appear valid. Edicts, restoration after Jia's death, mourning, and terrace construction all fit the year. The p029 AD 300 hint likely comes from Jiang Tong's elegy after burial in s0169 rather than the undated remonstrance.

Wang Huifeng's AD 300 hint in p038 is likely wrong if December belongs to 299, though it could align with an erroneous 300 AD dating. The same calendar problem affects Zhang Hua's p015 entry. Claim-181's "三月前" sourceDate is not present in the original text; it was constructed from the narrative sequence.

Claim-183 is supported by Jia Nanfeng's death in Yongkang 1 (300). Claim-186's condolence text fits the post-restoration period. Claims-187 and 188 are reasonable for Yan Zuan's burial elegies. Claim-115 cites two undated sources, s0015 and s0120, which weakens its attestation.

Claim-115 cites the dated murder in s0120 alongside the undated envy in s0015, which is problematic. Claims 134–139 correctly place tutors between Emperor Hui’s accession in 290 and Yuankang 1 in 291.

元康元年 is confirmed as the contextual date for companion assignments in s0205. The p017 entry for Wei Guan is correct as an undated father. Sima Yu's birth year is intentionally omitted per instructions. The p069 death in 302 needs verification against the Tai'an 1 calendar. 永甯元年正月 corresponds to 301.

Claim-208 is supported: Sima Lun’s usurpation in 永甯元年正月 corresponds to 301. p002’s AD 300 hint lacks an explicit dated attestation for the Emperor Hui; it may derive from his participation in the deposition and restoration narrative. p038’s AD 300 hint is similarly unsupported, since only the undated betrothal claim exists and no dated event is recorded for her in 300.

The instructions prohibit inventing hints from undated evidence alone. Since Wang Huifeng has no dated personal claim in 300, the AD 300 hint cannot be justified. The s0065 event is her own, yet it still lacks a dated claim.

The person check should flag missing narrative context rather than treat the AD 300 hint as unsupported. The hint check requires a source-specific English sentence identifying the named person’s own event, or noting its absence.

Wang Huifeng’s recall as mother in s0177 occurred after Zang’s succession in 永康元年四月, placing it in 300. This supports her AD 300 hint even without an owned claim. The same logic applies to p029: Jiang Tong’s elegy after burial in s0169 is a personal event in 300.

He Shao’s AD 300 hint in p011 shares the same 十二月 dating ambiguity. The missing nine-year-sixth-month omen is acceptable because it was not extracted. Converting 元康九年十二月 to the Gregorian calendar requires an authoritative source, since a Chinese twelfth month typically spans late December 299 to early January 300.

Fetching authoritative calendar data to resolve the December-to-Gregorian conversion. Claim-104’s 明年正月 (300) is correct regardless of whether December belongs to 299 or 300. Claim-176’s Liu Zhen 明年正月 (300) is also sound. The six-month burial date, Tai'an 1, and Shang’s August 301 date still need verification.

Standard chronology places the crown prince’s deposition in Yuankang 9 (299), his removal to Xuchang in Yongkang 1 (300), and his murder in Yongkang 1 (300). This resolves the December-to-Gregorian ambiguity.

Standard chronology places Jia Nanfeng’s death in Yongkang 1 (300) fourth month and burial in sixth month. Wikipedia and histories date the deposition to December 299 (Yuankang 9). This confirms claim-103 and all December-to-300 claims are likely wrong. The twelfth month of 299 probably belongs to 299, not 300. I will fetch the Academia Sinica calendar converter to verify. Month and day events must be normalized to proleptic Gregorian, defaulting to Julian before 1582.

Calculating the exact calendar offset between Julian and proleptic Gregorian around 300 AD. The 1582 reform skipped ten days, and the difference accumulates by one day per century except in leap centuries. The 4th, 8th, 12th, and 16th centuries are all divisible by 400, so they were leap years under both systems. This means the two calendars likely diverged by only about one day in the 300 AD era.

The Academia Sinica converter defaults to Julian before 1582. Near New Year, this can shift the Western year by one. The Chinese date stays fixed. The Julian witness must be identified explicitly. If the twelfth month of 299 AD falls in January, it may convert to December 299 or January 300 depending on which calendar system is used.

Zizhi Tongjian confirms the crown prince was deposed in Yuankang 9 (299) and moved to Xuchang in Yongkang 1 (300). The December-to-300 claims are likely conflating the month with the year. Precise lunar-to-western conversion is required to resolve this. Other potential issues are now being reviewed.

Claim-181’s “三月前” sourceDate is not quoted from the source; it is a constructed inference. Claim-187’s “葬後” is also invented, since the original text only provides contextual context after the burial. Neither date should be treated as an explicit source citation.

Claim-186’s “哀策” is a document type, not a date, so it is an odd sourceDate. Claim-183’s “賈庶人死後” is contextual after Jia’s death. Claim-248/290’s “太安初” maps to AD 302, which is slightly overprecise for a beginning-of-era label; “初” suggests the start of the Tai'an period, so 302 is conventional but could use westernBounds.

Claims 125 and 126 cite Tai'an 1 March 302 but omit the proleptic Gregorian conversion. The instructions require normalizing month and day events to proleptic Gregorian and stating the conversion convention. Year-only precision for these dates may be incomplete rather than incorrect.

Year-only precision for Tai'an 1 March may be acceptable if no specific day is claimed. The AD 302 year for that month still needs verification against lunar new-year conventions. p002’s AD 300 hint is supported by Emperor Hui’s active role in 300, even though no owned dated claim exists for that year.

The p069 hint list includes AD 302, which corresponds to the death in Tai'an 1 month 3. The workflow forbids feeding death years into activity hints. Since death is a personal event, it is unclear whether this hint should be allowed. I need to verify whether the workflow treats death years as valid hints.

AD 300 is both a death year and an active year for the Emperor Hui, since his deposition and death both occurred in 300. For p028, the death in 正月 300 confirms he was alive in that month, so the AD 300 hint may be death-only.

Lady Xie and Consort Jiang’s deaths in 十二月 300 share the same December-to-year ambiguity. Jia Nanfeng’s death is conventionally dated to April 300, so the claim-276 300 date is likely wrong. The December-to-year conversion issue affects multiple death claims.

Jia Nanfeng’s death is dated to 300 by narrative sequence alone, since the chapter names her death without specifying a month or day. Her execution and burial follow later in the same year, so the year is supported by context even without a named Yongkang date. The same 300 year applies to Liu Zhen, Cheng Ju, and Sun Lü, whose deaths are described as occurring after Jia’s death. Claim-115’s evidence cites s0120, the murder, for an undated envy claim.

Claim-115 cites s0120, the murder, as evidence for an undated envy claim. This is sloppy but acceptable because the claim itself is undated attestation.

Birth years are correctly omitted for p001, p068, and p069. p028’s undated birth claim-294 is appropriate.

The death in claim-107 is dated 三月, AD 300. If this is Yongkang 1 month 3, it falls in March–April 300. The burial in claim-198 is 六月己卯, which is Yongkang 1 month 6. The day still needs verification, though the year 300 is conventional.

Era 永甯 and 永寧 are identical, both AD 301. The 元康元年 attestation in claim-102 is accurate. Converting 惠帝即位 to 290 in claims 111 and 193 relies on external knowledge of the accession date, which may need a documented calendar or historical reference.

The 290 year for 惠帝即位 requires an external calendar reference. Emperor Hui acceded in 290, the same year his father died, followed by 永熙 and 元康元年 in 291. Tutor appointments likely fall in 290 or early 291, before the Eastern Palace move.

The onOrAfter 290 bound is correct. An event after an accession can still occur in that same year. Claim-208’s 301 date is accurate. p054’s AD 300 is supported by its永康元年 appointment even if December 299. p062, p065, and p011’s AD 300 dates are also confirmed.

He Shao’s AD 300 hint is unsupported if December 299 is the correct year, since he only appears in 290–291 appointments and a December 299 deposition. The same December-to-year problem affects Zhang Hua, p037, and p043–p054. I must convert 元康九年十二月 to determine the correct year. I will also fetch calendar converters and the source page, and locate the reviewer name in run-info.

I am checking several calendar converters and Wikipedia entries to resolve the December-to-year ambiguity. The Academia Sinica sinocal site may offer a JavaScript API or form. I am also reviewing Zizhi Tongjian dates and alternative sources such as 360doc.

元康九年十二月可能始于299年12月30日或31日 Julian，或进入1月。己卯在永康元年六月的干支转换仍需核实。我将搜索并抓取公开页面，包括 Academia Sinica，这不违反免费使用限制。外部引用的文本片段需要计算SHA-256哈希。关于日期标注：若十二月是 Yuankang 9 的第12个月，常规 reign-year 标签为299；但“conventional regnal year labels need not equal the Gregorian year of every month/day within them”，因此299与300的年份差异可能仅是标签惯例问题，未必构成事实错误。

Assigning AD 300 to a Yuankang 9 month 12 event is imprecise when the month spans two years. The event could belong to 299 or 300. The best repair is to use westernYear 299, westernBounds, or leave the date unresolved.

Claim-104’s 明年正月 = 300 is correct. The year follows Yuankang 9 directly into Yongkang 1. The s0044 九年六月 label is unambiguous. It refers to Yuankang 9. This is standard Jin Shu biography numbering. The December-to-year conversion must still be resolved.

December cannot be AD 300. If it were, Yongkang 1 would begin in 301, contradicting the confirmed AD 300 dates for Bin’s death and the Yongkang chronology. December is the twelfth month of the year before Yongkang 1, so the conventional year is 299. The remaining question is whether the entire lunar month falls within the Gregorian year 300.

Chinese New Year 300 would begin Yongkang 1. The twelfth month of Yuankang 9 therefore spans late December 299 to late January 300. Without a specific day, the event cannot be pinned to a single Gregorian year. The correct representation keeps the conventional reign-year label of 299.

Exact westernYear 300 is incorrect. The correct representation is onOrAfter 299 and onOrBefore 300, or a westernInterval. The extractor likely assumed the entire twelfth month fell in 300. These claims should be flagged as incorrect.

己巳在永康元年四月之后，因此 claim-245 的 AD 300 年份标注合理。p069 的永寧元年八月和太安元年三月均落在各自年份内。已核对 ownedUnits 中的出生、死亡和年龄提取情况，目前未发现遗漏。

Further owned-unit checks confirm no omitted birth, death, or age claims. s0171, s0183, s0209, s0065, s0077, and s0131 all yield correct extractions. p001 correctly omits a birth claim because its source only records parentage without a date.

s0044 的九年六月属于占卜记录，不属于个人生活事件，因此无需提取为日期声明。s0180 的五月是 Lun 与 Zang 进入东宫的活动，而 p054 和 p068 的相关记录已分别提取为 claim-208 与 claim-209，因此该条 dated event 不应视为遗漏。s0017 的出生记录正确提取，s0170 的三子虽无出生日期，但也不应额外推断。

s0180 的五月东宫之行是 dated personal event not yet in claims. I will flag it as a person-check omission. I must keep the audit narrow and avoid expanding into new biographies or external dates.

s0167 的 posthumous name is undated and follows burial sequence, so omitting it as an honor claim is acceptable. s0130 is a burial rite. The audit will focus on actual date defects rather than every missing honor. Posthumous grants such as claim-243 and claim-289 are correctly preserved as separate reception claims.

claim-248 的 posthumous 追諡 302 年份不会误入 p068 的活动提示，因为该年份属于死亡而非生活事件。p028 的 AD 300 提示也合理：若 December 属于 299，则他于 299–300 生活，正月 300 的死亡与四月的追諡都落在同一 Gregorian 年份内。

p038 的 AD 300 提示可由 s0177 的召回事件支撑，因为该召回发生在 300 年。p026 的 300 年份同样有 March 杀害和死亡作为依据，且暗示词不必完整覆盖所有年份。接下来将排查其他有问题的声明。

claim-178–180 的“太子既廢後”被标为 300，但若废黜发生在 Yuankang 9 十二月（299），该阴谋活动实际横跨 late 299 与 early 300，精确年份标注并不完全准确。He Qiao 等人的日期提取没有问题。

p004 的无活动提示合理，其童年事件未标日期，且该人物于 290 年去世，早于惠帝即位。

p002 的 AD 300 与 301 均有明确依据：AD 300 的 December 事件来自 s0058，AD 301 的迁金墉来自 s0183 及 claim-113。

claim-181 的“三月前”属于虚构的 sourceDate，因为三月是实际的 poisoning 月份，该声明不应保留。

s0059 的 December defense confirms Pei Wei (p047) was active in AD 300. He Shao (p007) held 太師 in s0202 and 太保 in s0063, so his AD 300 hint is consistent. 元康元年 is 291 and Yuankang 9 is 299, confirming the year arithmetic.

I will check ChineseNotes and Academia Sinica for the exact calendar conversion of Yuankang 9 month 12. The reviewer name will be set to "independent-reviewer" or pulled from run-info, with jobId 53569f184e8e8807113f and a current UTC timestamp. Claim-102 and claim-195 both correctly identify the 元康元年 Eastern Palace. p001 currently lacks an AD 299 hint, though the December deposition would place it there if December is 299.

December events should be marked 299, while 300 remains for imprisonment, murder, and burial. This is a hints finding. Death claims for Sima Shang and p026 are accurate. Sima Shang has no place of death. p026’s death is only a status declaration with no cause or manner.

Empress Yang and Emperor Xuan are correctly undated. The reception dated 300 for claim-284 is accurate because it marks the restoration edict, not the historical event itself. Historian appraisals such as claim-287/288 are appropriately undated.

s0158 的 壺關幹主, 千秋悟己 已正确识别为 p072 与 p073。p029 江通的 claim-150 是无日期的规谏，其 AD 300 提示合理。

p029 的无日期规谏不应标为 300。若该事件发生在 December 299 废黜之前，则 AD 300 提示更可能来自 s0169 的葬后挽诗，而非规谏本身。p066 的 Yan Zuan 被动地因皇帝受其言辞感动而获得 300 年份，该提示缺乏主动活动依据。

Yan Zuan 的 AD 300 提示合理，因为“立思子台”是葬后才建的 terrace，与皇帝受其言辞感动有关。Lu Ji 的 300 年份也正确。但 p027 的 Consort Jiang 若 December 死亡属 299，则 AD 300 提示错误。这是规律：若某人唯一 dated 事件是 十二月，其 300 年份提示通常不成立。

p011 He Shao 的 December 事件与 290–291 年份重叠，其 AD 300 提示可能不成立。p053 Sima Dan 的 December 事件与 明年正月 押送许昌（300）并存，因此该 300 年份提示合理。其余仅含 December 事件的个体，其 AD 300 提示均存在同样的年份归属疑虑。

s0065 的澹以兵仗送与 s0064 的废黜发生在同一天，进一步确认 December 事件横跨 late 299 与 early 300。p015 张华的 December 事件同样依赖 December 年份归属。接下来将获取公开日历页面并计算引用文本的 SHA256 哈希，同时准备对所有已拥有条目进行最终核查。

已列出全部需审计的条目清单，涵盖 claims、hints 与 personChecks，总数较大，必须逐项核对、去重、不遗漏。同时正在重新评估 December 是否应归入 300 年，因为该月可能主要落在 Gregorian 年 300 内，仍需查证实际日期。

Zizhi Tongjian and historians place the twelfth month of Yuankang 9 in 299. The instructions forbid assuming a reign-year label equals the Gregorian year of every day inside it, and forbid applying a fixed offset across centuries. December is a month, not merely a year label, so AD 300 cannot be inferred from it alone.
The December-year conversion looks like the main risk. I’ll verify the era dates and lunar months against calendar sources before scoring claims.

The Wikipedia calendar table for 元康九年 (299 AD) provides useful context.

元康九年十二月癸巳 (January 8) begins the year. If the month is large, the thirtieth day falls on February 6. That date also marks the start of 永康元年正月癸亥朔. This suggests the two months may share a single day.

The off-by-one discrepancy likely stems from Julian versus Gregorian calendars or inclusive counting. The entire twelfth month of 元康九年 falls within January–February AD 300. Therefore, AD 300 is the correct year for the twelfth month.

The instruction explicitly permits conventional regnal years to differ from their Gregorian equivalents. This validates the extractor’s assignment of AD 300 to the twelfth month. Jin Shu records the same date as the month’s final day. I will now fetch the Wikipedia and Academia Sinica sources to verify these details.

A conflict exists between the Annals and the Biography for 永康元年六月的葬礼日期. The Annals record 壬寅, while the Biography records 己卯. Both witnesses must be preserved. The year 300 remains valid under either reading.

The biography’s 己卯 date for 永康元年六月葬礼 is supported by the chapter’s own claims. The year 300 is therefore correct. The Annals confirm the death of the crown prince on 太安元年三月癸卯, placing that month in AD 302. The biography records the enthronement of Zang as heir on 五月己巳, which the chapter assigns to AD 300. The year is consistent across both witnesses.

The biography omits the month for the enthronement date, yet the year 300 remains sound. The burial date conflict does not challenge the year itself. The惠帝即位 date of 290 is supported by the Emperor Wu death on 太熙元年四月己酉, and 元康元年 = 291 is likewise confirmed. With the December year resolved, the next step is to hunt for remaining defects. One potential issue is claim-115, which cites s0120 for an undated envy claim.

Invented sourceDates such as 三月前 and 葬後 may be incorrect. The AD 300 hint in p002 is supported because Hui was active that year. A death-year hint in p028 is questionable because the instruction says to keep birth and death separate from activity. Yet death is a personal event, and many systems include death years in hints.

Death-year hints are treated as supported because death is a life date, not a posthumous event. The AD 300 hints in p038, p029, and p069 are all grounded in dated events. Claim-181’s “三月前” sourceDate is not present in the source text, so it may be incorrect.

Claim-181’s “三月前” sourceDate is inferred from the narrative sequence rather than the source text itself. The event is correctly dated to before March 300, so it is supported.

Claim-186’s “哀策” is a document title, not a date, though its year 300 is accurate.

Claim-248’s 太安初 is supported because 太安元年 is 302 and 初 means the beginning of that year.

p001’s age of twenty-three in 300 is supported by the absence of a birth date. s0044’s “九年六月” is an omen, not a personal event, so it is acceptable. For p017, the 元康元年 assignment is for the sons, not for Wei Guan, so leaving him undated is correct.

Claim-291 omits the dateContext wrapper used elsewhere for deaths, yet the year 300 is supported by the execution following Jia’s death. The AD 300 hint in p055 is valid because the jailer was active from 正月 and executed after Jia’s death. The AD 300 hint for Zhang Hua comes from the December defense in this chapter; the chapter did not fabricate his death from another source.

Pei Wei died in April 300 according to the Annals, though the chapter only records his December defense. The p026 death hint is supported because the narrative places it after the March murder and before the June burial. The year 300 is confirmed by the clear temporal sequence. The惠帝即位 year of 290 requires an external reference for its conversion. The tutor bounds are placed between 290 and 291, after the accession and before 元康元年.

The tutor appointments are correctly bounded between 290 and 291. The narrative places the selection immediately after 惠帝即位 and the Eastern Palace move in 元康元年. The hints in p012–p016 match these bounds exactly.

He Shao and Zhang Hua are correctly dated to AD 300. The companions entry is supported as 291 because it follows the Yuankang 1 edict. Claim-208’s 301 year for Lun’s usurpation is sound. Sima Zang’s death in AD 301 is consistent with the 正月 move to Jinyong. The exact month of 太安元年三月 still needs verification. The惠帝即位 year will be checked against the Jin Shu chronicles.

Only two ages appear in the chapter, and both were extracted. The hints for Princess Changguang and Lady of Yicheng are correctly empty because their events are absent or undated. Claim-243 and claim-289 are distinct: one records a posthumous noble title grant, the other a retrospective reception. These do not conflict.

Claim-243’s posthumous noble title is a life-adjacent claim. The instructions permit legitimate posthumous receptions as events but forbid them in personal activity. The dual claims—posthumous grant plus retrospective reception—are the intended pattern. The life claim should be removed separately.

The posthumous noble title in claim-243 is explicitly posthumously-granted, so it is not a misleading life claim. The AD 300 hint in p028 reflects the January death, not the title alone. Claim-248’s追諡 honor for Zang is also posthumous and properly paired with the reception claim. The hint for p068 correctly excludes 302.

The burial-place association in p001 is a funeral event and is acceptable. Month-and-day claims such as 六月己卯, 太安元年三月癸卯, and 己巳 lack a stated conversion convention. The western year is still correct, but the day-to-Gregorian normalization is missing.

The instructions require proleptic Gregorian normalization for month-and-day events. The current entries use year precision only, omitting day-level conversion. Chinese Wikipedia typically defaults to the Gregorian calendar, while Academia Sinica defaults to the Julian calendar before 1582. The two calendars differ by roughly one day around AD 300, so the conversion convention must be specified.

At AD 300 the Julian and proleptic Gregorian calendars differ by roughly one day. This gap is too small to alter the year near New Year. The元康九年十二月和永康元年正月 dates therefore remain valid under either convention.

The year-level dates for the burial and the 太安元年三月 event are identical under both Julian and proleptic Gregorian conventions. The conversion evidence should note this agreement. A correct year does not invalidate the claim. Claim-110’s “三月” death date aligns with s0120, where the murder process begins in March and the death occurs at age 23.

# 晉書/卷004

| 帝紀第三 ◄ | 晉書 卷四 帝紀第四 | ► 帝紀第五 |
| --- | --- | --- |

孝惠皇帝諱衷，字正度，武帝第二子也。泰始三年，立爲皇太子，時年九歲。 

## 太熙元年

太熙元年四月己酉，武帝崩。是日，皇太子即皇帝位，大赦，改元爲永熙。尊皇后楊氏曰皇太后，立妃賈氏爲皇后。 

夏五月辛未，葬武皇帝於峻陽陵。丙子，增天下位一等，預喪事者二等，復租調一年，二千石已上皆封關中侯。以太尉楊駿爲太傅，輔政。 

秋八月壬午，立廣陵王遹爲皇太子，以中書監何劭爲太子太師，吏部尚書王戎爲太子太傅，衛將軍楊濟爲太子太保。遣南中郎將石崇、射聲校尉胡奕、長水校尉趙俊、揚烈將軍趙歡將屯兵四出。 

冬十月辛酉，以司空石鑒爲太尉，前鎮西將軍、隴西王泰爲司空。 

## 元康元年

永平元年春正月乙酉朔 [1] ，臨朝，不設樂。詔曰：「朕夙遭不造，淹恤在疚。賴祖宗遺靈，宰輔忠賢，得以眇身託于群后之上。昧於大道，不明于訓，戰戰兢兢，夕惕若厲。乃者哀迷之際，三事股肱，惟社稷之重，率遵翼室之典，猶欲長奉先皇之制，是以有永熙之號。然日月踰邁，已涉新年，開元易紀，禮之舊章。其改永熙二年爲永平元年。」又詔子弟及群官並不得謁陵。丙午，皇太子冠，丁未，見于太廟。 

二月甲寅，賜王公已下帛各有差。癸酉，鎮南將軍楚王瑋、鎮東將軍淮南王允來朝。戊寅，復置祕書監官。 

三月辛卯，誅太傅楊駿，駿弟衛將軍珧，太子太保濟，中護軍張劭，散騎常侍段廣、楊邈，左將軍劉預，河南尹李斌，中書令蔣俊，東夷校尉文淑，尚書武茂，皆夷三族。壬辰，大赦，改元。賈后矯詔廢皇太后爲庶人，徙于金墉城，告于天地宗廟。誅太后母龐氏。壬寅，徵大司馬、汝南王亮爲太宰，與太保衛瓘輔政。以秦王柬爲大將軍，東平王楙爲撫軍大將軍，鎮南將軍、楚王瑋爲衛將軍，領北軍中候，下邳王晃爲尚書令，東安公繇爲尚書左僕射，進封東安王。督將侯者千八十一人。庚戌，免東安王繇及東平王楙，繇徙帶方。 

夏四月癸亥，以征東將軍、梁王肜爲征西大將軍、都督關西諸軍事，太子少傅阮坦爲平東將軍、監青徐二州諸軍事。己巳，以太子太傅王戎爲尚書右僕射。 

五月甲戌 [2] ，毗陵王軌薨。壬午，除天下戶調綿絹，賜孝悌、高年、鰥寡、力田者帛，人三匹。 

六月，賈后矯詔使楚王瑋殺太宰、汝南王亮，太保、菑陽公衛瓘。乙丑，以瑋擅害亮、瓘，殺之。曲赦洛陽。以廣陵王師劉寔爲太子太保，司空、隴西王泰錄尚書事。 

秋七月，分揚州、荊州十郡爲江州。 

八月庚申，以趙王倫爲征東將軍、都督徐兗二州諸軍事；河間王顒爲北中郎將，鎮鄴；太子太師何劭爲都督豫州諸軍事，鎮許昌。徙長沙王乂爲常山王。己巳，進西陽公羕爵爲王。辛未，立隴西世子越爲東海王。 

九月甲午，大將軍、秦王柬薨。辛丑，徵征西大將軍、梁王肜爲衛將軍、錄尚書事，以趙王倫爲征西大將軍、都督雍梁二州諸軍事。 

冬十二月辛酉，京師地震。 

是歲，東夷十七國、南夷二十四部並詣校尉內附。 

## 元康二年

二年春二月己酉，賈后弒皇太后于金墉城。 

秋八月壬子，大赦。 

九月乙酉，中山王耽薨。 

冬十一月，大疫。 

是歲，沛國雨雹，傷麥。 

## 元康三年

三年夏四月，滎陽雨雹。 

六月，弘農郡雨雹，深三尺。 

冬十月，太原王泓薨。 [3] 

## 元康四年

四年春正月丁酉朔，侍中、太尉、安昌公石鑒薨。 [4] 

夏五月，蜀郡山移，淮南壽春洪水出，山崩地陷，壞城府及百姓廬舍。匈奴郝散反，攻上黨，殺長吏。 

六月，壽春地大震，死者二十餘家。上庸郡山崩，殺二十餘人。 

秋八月，郝散帥眾降，馮翊都尉殺之。上谷居庸、上庸並地陷裂，水泉涌出，人有死者。大饑。 

九月丙辰，赦諸州之遭地災者。甲午，枉矢東北竟天。 [5] 

是歲，京師及郡國八地震。 

## 元康五年

五年夏四月，彗星見于西方，孛于奎，至軒轅。

## 元康九年

九年春正月，左積弩將軍孟觀伐氐，戰于中亭，大破之，獲齊萬年。徵征西大將軍、梁王肜錄尚書事。以北中郎將、河間王顒爲鎮西將軍，鎮關中；成都王穎爲鎮北大將軍，鎮鄴。 

夏四月，鄴人張承基等妖言署置，聚黨數千。郡縣逮捕，皆伏誅。 

六月戊戌，太尉、隴西王泰薨。 [7] 

秋八月，以尚書裴頠爲尚書僕射。 

冬十一月甲子朔，日有蝕之。京師大風，發屋折木。 

十二月壬戌，廢皇太子遹爲庶人，及其三子幽于金墉城，殺太子母謝氏。 

## 永康元年

永康元年春正月癸亥朔，大赦，改元。己卯，日有蝕之。丙子，皇孫𧇃卒。 [8] 

二月丁酉，大風，飛沙拔木。 

三月，尉氏雨血，妖星見于南方。癸未，賈后矯詔害庶人遹于許昌。 

夏四月辛卯，日有蝕之。癸巳，梁王肜、趙王倫矯詔廢賈后爲庶人，司空張華、尚書僕射裴頠皆遇害，侍中賈謐及黨與數十人皆伏誅。甲午，倫矯詔大赦，自爲相國、都督中外諸軍，如宣文輔魏故事，追復故皇太子位。丁酉，以梁王肜爲太宰，左光祿大夫何劭爲司徒，右光祿大夫劉寔爲司空，淮南王允爲驃騎將軍。己亥，趙王倫矯詔害賈庶人于金墉城。 

五月己巳，立皇孫臧爲皇太孫，尚爲襄陽王。 

六月壬寅，葬愍懷太子于顯平陵。撫軍將軍、清河王遐薨。癸卯，震崇陽陵標。 

秋八月，淮南王允舉兵討趙王倫，不克，允及其二子秦王郁、漢王迪皆遇害。曲赦洛陽。平東將軍、彭城王植薨。改封吳王晏爲賓徒縣王。以齊王冏爲平東將軍，鎮許昌；光祿大夫陳準爲太尉、錄尚書事。 

九月，改司徒爲丞相，以梁王肜爲之。 

冬十月，黃霧四塞。 

十一月戊午，大風飛沙石，六日乃止。甲子，立皇后羊氏，大赦，大酺三日。 

十二月，彗星見于東方。益州刺史趙廞與略陽流人李庠害成都內史耿勝 [9] 、犍爲太守李密、汶山太守霍固 [10] 、西夷校尉陳總，據成都反。 

## 永寧元年

永寧元年春正月乙丑，趙王倫篡帝位。丙寅，遷帝于金墉城，號曰太上皇，改金墉曰永昌宮。廢皇太孫臧爲濮陽王。五星經天，縱橫無常。癸酉，倫害濮陽王臧。略陽流人李特殺趙廞，傳首京師。 

三月，平東將軍、齊王冏起兵以討倫 [11] ，傳檄州郡，屯于陽翟。征北大將軍、成都王穎，征西大將軍、河間王顒，常山王乂，豫州刺史李毅 [12] ，兗州刺史王彥，南中郎將、新野公歆，皆舉兵應之，眾數十萬。倫遣其將閭和出伊闕，張泓、孫輔出堮阪以距冏，孫會、士猗、許超出黃橋以距穎。及穎將趙驤、石超戰于湨水，會等大敗，棄軍走。 

閏月丙戌朔，日有蝕之。 

夏四月，歲星晝見。冏將何勖、盧播擊張泓於陽翟，大破之，斬孫輔等。辛酉，左衛將軍王輿與尚書、淮陵王漼勒兵入宮，禽倫黨孫秀、孫會、許超、士猗、駱休等，皆斬之。逐倫歸第，即日乘輿反正。群臣頓首謝罪，帝曰：「非諸卿之過也。」 

癸亥，詔曰：「朕以不德，纂承皇統，遠不能光濟大業，靖綏四方；近不能開明刑威，式遏姦宄，至使逆臣孫秀敢肆凶虐，窺間王室，遂奉趙王倫饕據天位。鎮東大將軍、齊王冏，征北大將軍、成都王穎，征西大將軍、河間王顒，並以明德茂親，忠規允著，首建大策，匡救國難。尚書漼共立大謀，左衛將軍王輿與群公卿士，協同謀略，親勒本營，斬秀及其二子。前趙王倫爲秀所誤，與其子等已詣金墉迎朕幽宮，旋軫閶闔。豈在予一人獨饗其慶，宗廟社稷實有賴焉。」於是大赦，改元，孤寡賜穀五斛，大酺五日。誅趙王倫、義陽王威、九門侯質等及倫之黨與。 

五月，立襄陽王尚爲皇太孫。 

六月戊辰，大赦，增吏位二等。復封賓徒王晏爲吳王。庚午，東萊王蕤、左衛將軍王輿謀廢齊王冏，事泄，蕤廢爲庶人，輿伏誅，夷三族。甲戌，以齊王冏爲大司馬、都督中外諸軍事，成都王穎爲大將軍、錄尚書事，河間王顒爲太尉。罷丞相，復置司徒官。己卯，以梁王肜爲太宰，領司徒。封齊王冏功臣葛旟牟平公，路季小黃公 [13] ，衛毅平陰公，劉真安鄉公，韓泰封丘公。 

秋七月甲午，立吳王晏子國爲漢王 [14] ，復封常山王乂爲長沙王。 

八月，大赦。戊辰，原徙邊者。益州刺史羅尚討羌，破之。己巳，徙南平王祥爲宜都王。下邳王韡薨 [15] 。以東平王楙爲平東將軍 [16] 、都督徐州諸軍事。 

九月，追東安王繇復其爵。丁丑 [17] ，封楚王瑋子範爲襄陽王。 

冬十月，流人李特反於蜀。 

十二月，司空何劭薨 [18] 。封齊王冏子冰爲樂安王，英爲濟陽王，超爲淮南王。 

是歲，郡國十二旱，六蝗。 

## 太安元年

太安元年春正月庚子，安東將軍、譙王隨薨。 

三月癸卯，赦司、冀、兗、豫四州。皇太孫尚薨。 

夏四月，彗星晝見。 

五月乙酉，侍中、太宰、領司徒、梁王肜薨。以右光祿大夫劉寔爲太傅。太尉、河間王顒遣將衙博擊李特於蜀，爲特所敗。特遂陷梓潼、巴西，害廣漢太守張微，自號大將軍 [19] 。癸卯，以清河王遐子覃爲皇太子，賜孤寡帛，大酺五日。以齊王冏爲太師，東海王越爲司空。 

秋七月，兗、豫、徐、冀等四州大水。 

冬十月，地震。
